headline: SEA @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.39 at PIT 3.79, with a projected total of 8.17. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (SEA -0.27, PIT -0.35), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.62, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Bryce Miller has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Cole Young, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colt Emerson, Mitch Garver because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
